issues.evidence:
Two empty

elements. No

landmark. Footer section labels (COMPANY INFORMATION etc.) are unsemantic divs, not headings.
8 <ul>/<ol> elements with list-style:none and no role='list' — VoiceOver/Safari list-semantics stripping risk.
scrollWidth 768 vs clientWidth 320 at 320px viewport (ratio 2.4). General layout elements overflow, not an exempt table/map.
Keyboard trap at the header search input. tabWalk.trapDetected=true; three consecutive Tab presses cycle on the same searchbox. Focus cannot escape to reach main page content.
Search input labelled only via title attribute. axe label-title-only fires. No persistent visible label, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby.

LinkedIn icon link: accessible name is a Unicode font-icon glyph (\uf0e1). display:none span with 'LinkedIn' text is excluded from name computation. axe link-name fires. All 9 social icon links share this pattern.
Promotional image alt='subscribe' does not describe its visual content (credit card offer with embedded promotional text).
